definitions.gloss: 42nd-day memorial service; sixth seven-day rite after death
definitions.explanation: In Japanese Buddhist funeral practice, a memorial rite held on the 42nd day after a death, the sixth of the seven weekly services observed during the 49-day mourning period.

examples.japanese: {六七日|むなのか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}んだ→営む：11837_itonamu⟧。
{六七日|むなのか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{近親者|きんしんしゃ}だけで⟦{静|しず}かに→静かに：18611_shizukani⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ことが⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: The 42nd-day service is often held quietly, with only close relatives present.

examples.japanese: {六七日|むなのか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、いよいよ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいて→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧くる。
examples.english: Once the 42nd-day service has passed, the 49th day at last draws near.

notes:
{六七日|むなのか} (literally "six sevens") is the sixth of the weekly Buddhist memorial services held after a death, falling on the 42nd day, the last of the smaller weekly rites before ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{五七日|いつなのか}→五七日：30934_itsunanoka⟧: 35th-day service (fifth)
- ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧: 49th-day service (seventh, final)

Like ⟦{四七日|よなのか}→四七日：30933_yonanoka⟧ and ⟦{五七日|いつなのか}→五七日：30934_itsunanoka⟧, {六七日|むなのか} is usually a small, private observance rather than a formal gathering.
